works.scope_note: Pure SU(2), four dimensions, trivial topological sector, fixed infrared cutoff, regularized axial gauge. Authors state existence of an ultraviolet limit of Schwinger functions and cutoff-adapted Slavnov identities. Printed pp.326-327 explicitly characterize convergence arguments as a detailed outline rather than a full self-contained proof; p.378 calls the argument a sketch of proof. They do not remove the infrared cutoff, investigate large gauge transformations/nontrivial topology, construct renormalized gauge-invariant composite observables, or establish the complete Osterwalder-Schrader axioms. Reflection positivity is proposed as additional work. These are precise scope limits of this source, not a judgment on repository results.
evidence_locators: PDF p.1 / printed p.325: abstract identifies SU(2), trivial topological sector, fixed infrared cutoff and no ultraviolet cutoff.
PDF pp.2-3 / printed pp.326-327: author qualifications about convergence-proof details; statement of UV Schwinger-limit existence and Slavnov identities; infrared/topological/OS-axiom limits.
PDF pp.4-5 / printed pp.328-329, section II.A and equations II.1-II.8: model, fixed infrared setup and axial gauge; gauge-invariant composite-operator constructions not provided.
PDF pp.53-54 / printed pp.377-378, section VIII equations VIII.1-VIII.6: cutoff-adapted Slavnov hierarchy, boundary/cutoff term E_N and vanishing ultraviolet error delta_N(rho).
